PhotoSlop · free, in your browser

Deep fry a picture for a meme

The deep fried look, on demand: oversaturated colour, harsh sharpening and layers of JPEG crunch. Drop in any picture, turn up the Crispiness, and add meme text with the Type tool.

Deep fry a picture

Watch the PhotoSlop tutorial: a free photo editor in the browser
On YouTube, about two minutes.

How to do it

  1. Open the picture with File > Open…, or paste it with Ctrl+V.
  2. Choose Filter > Slop > Deep Fry… and set the Crispiness. Change the Seed for a different grain.
  3. Add more if you want: JPEG Crunch…, Glitch…, Chromatic Aberration… or VHS Tape… sit in the same menu.
  4. Add text with the Horizontal Type Tool (T), with a Stroke layer style for the classic outline.
  5. Choose File > Export As… and save it as JPEG or PNG.

Your files stay on this device: PhotoSlop runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

How do I make it even more fried?

Run Deep Fry again, or follow it with JPEG Crunch and raise the number of generations. Each pass adds more artefacts.

Can I undo it?

Yes. Edit > Undo (Ctrl+Z) takes the filter off, and the History panel goes back further.

Does it add a watermark?

No. The picture is saved exactly as it looks, with no watermark and no sign-up.

Can I start from a meme template size?

Yes. File > New… has a Meme preset, along with Instagram, HD, 4K and other sizes.
